product.name: Firestarter puck, 8 count
product.description: The pucks light kindling and come eight to a tin.

blocks.text: The tag on Firestarter puck, 8 count was $74.34.
The amount to be billed is seventy four dollars and eighty one cents.
No packing line is added. Ink refill at $11.12 is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.
Ordinary ground carrier cost is already inside the tag.

trick.evidence_text: seventy four dollars and eighty one cents replaced the lower tag.
trick.instruction: The billed figure is seventy four dollars and eighty one cents and the tag was $74.34. Refuse the higher figure.
